name: Crushed Ice
description: (H<sub>2</sub>O) A slush of crushed, semi-solid ice.

name: Diamond
description:
(C) Diamond is industrial-grade, high density carbon.

It is very difficult to excavate.

name: Isosap
description:
Isosap is a crystallized sap composed of long-chain polymers.

It is used in the production of rare, high grade materials.

name: Sucrose
description:
(C<sub>12</sub>H<sub>22</sub>O<sub>11</sub>) Sucrose is the raw form of sugar.

It can be used for cooking higher-quality <link="FOOD">Food</link>.

name: Peat
description:
Peat is a densely packed material made up of partially decomposed organic matter.

It is a combustible fuel, useful in <link="POWER">Power</link> production.

name: Zinc Ore
description:
(Zn) Zinc Ore is a malleable raw <link="METALORE">Metal</link>.

It is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Algae
description:
Algae is a cluster of non-motile, single-celled lifeforms.

It can be used to produce <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> when used in an <link="MINERALDEOXIDIZER">Oxygen Diffuser</link>.

name: Brackwax
description: Brackwax is a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> byproduct of <link="MILK">Brackene</link>.

name: Niobium
description: (Nb) Niobium is a rare metal with many practical applications in metallurgy and superconductor <link="RESEARCH">Research</link>.

name: Nickel
description:
(Ni) Nickel is a conductive <link="METAL">Metal</link>.

It is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Frozen Brackene
description: Frozen Brackene is <link="MILK">Brackene</link> frozen into a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Copper Ore
description:
(Cu<sub>2</sub>O) Copper Ore is a conductive <link="METAL">Metal</link>.

It is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Copper
description:
(Cu) Copper is a conductive <link="METAL">Metal</link>.

It is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Crushed Rock
description: Crushed Rock is <link="IGNEOUSROCK">Igneous Rock</link> crushed into a mechanical mixture.

name: Insulite
description: Insulite reduces <link="HEAT">Heat Transfer</link> and is composed of recrystallized <link="KATAIRITE">Abyssalite</link>.

name: Shale
description: Shale is a brittle composite of sediment layers. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Corallium
description: Corallium is a dense coral primarily composed of (CaCO3) Lime. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Gum Wood
description: Gum Wood can be processed at the Plant Pulverizer to yield Latex, which is essential for Rubber production. It can also be used for Heat and Power, or as a Construction Material.

name: Tallow
description: A chunk of raw grease that can be used in <link="FOOD">Food</link> production or industrial processes.

name: Brine Ice
description:
Brine Ice is a natural, highly concentrated solution of <link="SALT">Salt</link> dissolved in <link="WATER">Water</link> and frozen into a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

It can be used in desalination processes, separating out usable salt.

name: Solid Visco-Gel
description:
Visco-Gel is a polymer that has high surface tension when in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> form.

This selection is in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Ceramic
description: Ceramic is a hard, brittle material formed from heated Clay. It is a reliable Construction Material.

name: Cobalt Ore
description:
(Co) Cobalt Ore is a blue-hued <link="BUILDINGMATERIALCLASSES">Metal</link>.

It is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Fertilizer
description:
Fertilizer is a processed mixture of biological nutrients.

It aids in the growth of certain <link="PLANTS">Plants</link>.

name: Wolframite
description:
((Fe,Mn)WO<sub>4</sub>) Wolframite is a dense Metallic element in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

It is a source of <link="TUNGSTEN">Tungsten</link> and is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Slime
description:
Slime is a thick biomixture of algae, fungi, and mucopolysaccharides.

It can be distilled into <link="ALGAE">Algae</link> and emits <link="CONTAMINATEDOXYGEN">Polluted Oxygen</link> once dug up.

name: Plastic
description:
(C<sub>3</sub>H<sub>6</sub>)<sub>n</sub> <link="POLYPROPYLENE">Plastic</link> is a thermoplastic polymer.

It is useful for constructing a variety of advanced buildings and equipment.

name: Amber
description: Amber is a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> organic composite of <link="NATURALRESIN">Resin</link> and <link="FOSSIL">Fossil</link>.

name: Solid Naphtha
description: Naphtha is a distilled hydrocarbon mixture in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Tungsten
description:
(W) Tungsten is an extremely tough crystalline <link="REFINEDMETAL">Metal</link>.

It is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Refined Carbon
description: (C) Refined carbon is solid element purified from raw <link="CARBON">Coal</link>.

name: Steel
description: Steel is a <link="REFINEDMETAL">Metal Alloy</link> composed of iron and carbon.

name: Phosphorite
description: Phosphorite is a composite of sedimentary rock, saturated with phosphate.

name: Solid Hydrogen
description: (H) Solid Hydrogen is the universe's most common element in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Bleach Stone
description:
Bleach stone is an unstable compound that emits unbreathable <link="CHLORINEGAS">Chlorine Gas</link>.

It is often used in <link="HANDSANITIZER">Hygienic</link> processes.

name: Lead
description:
(Pb) Lead is a soft yet extremely dense <link="REFINEDMETAL">Refined Metal</link>.

It has a low Overheat Temperature and is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Sulfur
description:
(S) Sulfur is a common chemical element and byproduct of <link="METHANE">Natural Gas</link> production.

This selection is in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Lime
description: (CaCO3) Lime is a mineral commonly found in Critter egg shells. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Solid Chlorine
description: (Cl) Chlorine is a natural <link="DISEASE">Germ</link>-killing element in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Frozen Mucin
description: Frozen Mucin is a chunk of <link="MUCUS">Mucin</link> cooled to a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Mercury
description: (Hg) Mercury is a rare <link="REFINEDMETAL">Metal</link> in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Solid Nuclear Waste
description: Highly toxic solid full of <link="RADIATION">Radioactive Contaminants</link>.

name: Coquina
description: Coquina is a brittle Solid mineral made up of the calcified remains of aquatic invertebrates. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Obsidian
description: Obsidian is a brittle composite of volcanic <link="GLASS">Glass</link>.

name: Solid Petroleum
description:
Petroleum is a <link="POWER">Power</link> source.

This selection is in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Solid Super Coolant
description:
Super Coolant is an industrial-grade <link="FULLERENE">Fullerene</link> coolant.

This selection is in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Igneous Rock
description: Igneous Rock is a composite of solidified volcanic rock. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Rubber
description:
Rubber is a viscoelastic <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> made from vulcanized <link="LATEX">Latex</link>.

It can be used to make <link="BUILDINGGASKET">Gaskets</link>.

name: Enriched Uranium
description:
(U) Enriched Uranium is a refined substance primarily used to <link="POWER">Power</link> potent research reactors.

It becomes highly <link="RADIATION">Radioactive</link> when consumed.

name: Siltstone
description: Siltstone is a chalky mudrock made primarily of compressed silt. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Gold
description:
(Au) Gold is a conductive precious <link="REFINEDMETAL">Metal</link>.

It is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Rust
description:
Rust is an iron oxide that forms from the breakdown of <link="IRON">Iron</link>.

It is useful in some <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> production processes.

name: Solid Gunk
description: Solid Gunk is the built-up grime and grit produced by Duplicants' bionic mechanisms, which has been frozen into a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Frozen Phyto Oil
description: Frozen Phyto Oil is thick, slippery <link="SLIME">Slime</link> extract, frozen into a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Corium
description:
A radioactive mixture of nuclear waste and melted reactor materials.

Releases <link="FALLOUT">Nuclear Fallout</link> gas.

name: Refined Phosphorus
description: (P) Refined Phosphorus is a chemical element in its <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Iridium
description: (Ir) Iridium is a firm and highly conductive <link="METAL">Metal</link> that can withstand extreme  <link="HEAT">Heat</link>.

name: Granite
description: Granite is a dense composite of Igneous Rock. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Radium
description:
(Ra) Radium is a <link="LIGHT">Light</link> emitting radioactive substance.

It is useful as a <link="POWER">Power</link> source.

name: Wood
description: Wood is a good source of Heat and Power. Its insulation properties and positive Decor also make it a useful Construction Material.

name: Solid Carbon Dioxide
description: (CO<sub>2</sub>) Carbon Dioxide is an unbreathable compound in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Cobalt
description: (Co) Cobalt is a <link="REFINEDMETAL">Refined Metal</link> made from <link="COBALTITE">Cobalt Ore</link>.

name: Uranium Ore
description:
(U) Uranium Ore is a highly <link="RADIATION">Radioactive</link> substance.

It can be refined into fuel for research reactors.

name: Solid Propane
description: (C<sub>3</sub>H<sub>8</sub>) Solid Propane is a natural gas in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Aluminum Ore
description:
Aluminum ore, also known as Bauxite, is a sedimentary rock high in metal content.

It can be refined into <link="ALUMINUM">Aluminum</link>.

name: Sedimentary Rock
description: Sedimentary Rock is a hardened composite of sediment layers. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Fullerene
description: (C<sub>60</sub>) Fullerene is a form of <link="CARBON">Coal</link> consisting of spherical molecules.

name: Gold Amalgam
description:
Gold Amalgam is a conductive amalgam of gold and mercury.

It is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Salt
description:
(NaCl) Salt, also known as sodium chloride, is an edible chemical compound.

When refined, it can be eaten with meals to increase Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: Sand
description:
Sand is a composite of granular rock.

It is useful as a <link="FILTER">Filtration Medium</link>.

name: Snow
description:
(H<sub>2</sub>O) Snow is a mass of loose, crystalline ice particles.

It becomes <link="WATER">Water</link> when melted.

name: Sandstone
description: Sandstone is a composite of relatively soft sedimentary rock. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Glass
description: Glass is a brittle, transparent substance formed from <link="SAND">Sand</link> fired at high temperatures.

name: Frozen Squid Ink
description: Frozen Ink is <link="INK">Squid Ink</link> cooled to a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Plywood
description: Plywood is a good source of Heat and Power. Its insulation properties make it a useful Construction Material.

name: Clay
description: Clay is a soft, naturally occurring composite of stone and soil that hardens at high Temperatures. It is a reliable Construction Material.

name: Polluted Dirt
description:
Polluted Dirt is unprocessed biological waste.

It emits <link="CONTAMINATEDOXYGEN">Polluted Oxygen</link> over time.

name: Ice
description: (H<sub>2</sub>O) Ice is clean water frozen into a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Graphite
description: (C) Graphite is the most stable form of carbon. It has high thermal conductivity and is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Polluted Mud
description:
A mixture of <link="TOXICSAND">Polluted Dirt</link> and <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

Can be separated into its base elements using a <link="SLUDGEPRESS">Sludge Press</link>.

name: Mud
description:
A mixture of <link="DIRT">Dirt</link> and <link="WATER">Water</link>.

Can be separated into its base elements using a <link="SLUDGEPRESS">Sludge Press</link>.

name: Coal
description:
(C) Coal is a combustible fossil fuel composed of carbon.

It is useful in <link="POWER">Power</link> production.

name: Solid Oxygen
description: (O<sub>2</sub>) Solid Oxygen is a breathable element in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Genetic Ooze
description:
(DuPe) Ooze is a slurry of water, carbon, and dozens and dozens of trace elements.

Duplicants are printed from pure Ooze.

name: Depleted Uranium
description:
(U) Depleted Uranium is <link="URANIUMORE">Uranium</link> with a low U-235 content.

It is created as a byproduct of <link="ENRICHEDURANIUM">Enriched Uranium</link> and is no longer suitable as fuel.

name: Abyssalite
description: (Ab) Abyssalite is a resilient, crystalline element.

name: Pearl
description: A perfectly smooth gem. It can be eaten by Seaquines or used as an attractive Construction Material.

name: Solid Methane
description: (CH<sub>4</sub>) Methane is an alkane in a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Frozen Ovolene
description: Frozen Ovolene is <link="FISHMILK">Ovolene</link> frozen into a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Plastium
description:
<link="HARDPOLYPROPYLENE">Plastium</link> is an advanced thermoplastic polymer made from <link="TEMPCONDUCTORSOLID">Thermium</link>, <link="POLYPROPYLENE">Plastic</link> and <link="MILKFAT">Brackwax</link>.

It is highly heat-resistant and suitable for use in space buildings.

name: Solid Resin
description:
Resin that has been cooled to a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

It can be treated to become <link="POLYPROPYLENE">Plastic</link> in the <link="POLYMERIZER">Polymer Press</link>.

name: Oxylite
description:
(Ir<sub>3</sub>O<sub>2</sub>) Oxylite is a chemical compound that slowly emits breathable <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link>.

Excavating <link="OXYROCK">Oxylite</link> increases its emission rate, but depletes the ore more rapidly.

name: Mafic Rock
description: Mafic Rock is a variation of Igneous Rock that is rich in Iron. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Polluted Brine Ice
description: Polluted Brine Ice is a murky, concentrated solution of <link="SALT">Salt</link> dissolved in <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link> and frozen into a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Iron
description: (Fe) Iron is a common industrial <link="REFINEDMETAL">Metal</link>.

name: Basalt
description: Basalt is a natural volcanic rock that forms when <link="MAGMA">Magma</link> cools rapidly.

name: Regolith
description:
Regolith is a sandy substance composed of the various particles that collect atop terrestrial objects.

It is useful as a <link="FILTER">Filtration Medium</link>.

name: Solid Sap
description:
Solidified goo harvested from a grumpy tree.

It is used in the production of <link="ISORESIN">Isosap</link>.

name: Nickel Ore
description:
(Ni) Nickel Ore is a conductive <link="METAL">Metal</link>.

It can be refined into <link="NICKEL">Nickel</link> and is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Bitumen
description: Bitumen is a sticky viscous residue left behind from <link="PETROLEUM">Petroleum</link> production.

name: Packed Snow
description:
(H<sub>2</sub>O) Snow is a mass of loose, crystalline ice particles.

It becomes <link="WATER">Water</link> when melted.

name: Thermium
description: Thermium is an industrial metal alloy formulated to maximize <link="HEAT">Heat Transfer</link> and thermal dispersion.

name: Iron Ore
description:
(Fe) Iron Ore is a soft <link="METAL">Metal</link>.

It is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Zinc
description: (Zn) Zinc is a very malleable <link="REFINEDMETAL">Metal Alloy</link>.

name: Dirt
description:
Dirt is a soft, nutrient-rich substance capable of supporting life.

It is necessary in some forms of <link="FOOD">Food</link> production.

name: Polluted Ice
description: Polluted Ice is dirty, unfiltered water frozen into a <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> state.

name: Fossil
description: Fossil is organic matter, highly compressed and hardened into a mineral state. It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Neutronium
description:
(Nt) Neutronium is a mysterious and extremely resilient element.

It cannot be excavated by any Duplicant mining tool.

name: Cinnabar Ore
description:
(HgS) Cinnabar Ore, also known as mercury sulfide, is a conductive <link="METAL">Metal</link> that can be refined into <link="MERCURY">Mercury</link>.

It is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Solid Ethanol
description:
(C<sub>2</sub>H<sub>6</sub>O) Solid Ethanol is an advanced chemical compound.

It can be used as a highly effective fuel source when burned.

name: Pyrite
description:
(FeS<sub>2</sub>) Pyrite is a conductive <link="METAL">Metal</link>.

Also known as "Fool's Gold", is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Galena
description: (PbS) Galena is a raw <link="METAL">Metal Ore</link> primarily composed of <link="LEAD">Lead</link> with <link="SULFUR">Sulfur</link> impurities.

name: Aluminum
description:
(Al) Aluminum is a low density <link="REFINEDMETAL">Metal</link>.

It has high Thermal Conductivity and is suitable for building <link="POWER">Power</link> systems.

name: Latex
description:
Latex is a naturally derived colloidal dispersion of polymer particles in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

It can be used to produce <link="RUBBER">Rubber</link>.

name: Polluted Brine
description:
Polluted Brine is a murky, concentrated solution of <link="SALT">Salt</link> dissolved in <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

It can be used in desalination processes, separating out usable salt.

name: Liquid Oxygen
description:
(O<sub>2</sub>) Oxygen is a breathable chemical.

This selection is in a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Visco-Gel Fluid
description: Visco-Gel Fluid is a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> polymer with high surface tension, preventing typical liquid flow and allowing for unusual configurations.

name: Molten Aluminum
description: (Al) Molten Aluminum is a low density <link="REFINEDMETAL">Metal</link> heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Molten Lead
description: (Pb) Lead is an extremely dense <link="REFINEDMETAL">Refined Metal</link> heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Liquid Carbon Dioxide
description:
(CO<sub>2</sub>) Carbon Dioxide is an unbreathable chemical compound.

This selection is currently in a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Crude Oil
description:
Crude Oil is a raw potential <link="POWER">Power</link> source composed of billions of dead, primordial organisms.

It is also a useful lubricant for certain types of machinery.

name: Molten Glass
description: Molten Glass is a composite of granular rock, heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Molten Iridium
description: (Ir) Molten Iridium is a highly conductive <link="METAL">Metal</link> heated to a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Biodiesel
description:
Biodiesel is a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> composed of highly processed fatty acids derived from purified natural oils.

Its <link="COMBUSTIBLELIQUID">combustibility</link> makes it useful for <link="POWER">Power</link> production.

name: Liquid Sulfur
description:
(S) Sulfur is a common chemical element and byproduct of <link="METHANE">Natural Gas</link> production.

This selection is in a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Molten Gold
description: (Au) Gold, a conductive precious <link="REFINEDMETAL">Metal</link>, heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Magma
description: Magma is a composite of <link="IGNEOUSROCK">Igneous Rock</link> heated into a molten, <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Liquid Chlorine
description: (Cl) Chlorine is a natural <link="DISEASE">Germ</link>-killing element in a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Liquid Hydrogen
description:
(H) Hydrogen in its <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

It freezes most substances that come into contact with it.

name: Sap
description:
Sticky goo harvested from a grumpy tree.

It can be polymerized into <link="ISORESIN">Isosap</link> by boiling away its excess moisture.

name: Gunk
description:
Gunk is the built-up grime and grit produced by Duplicants' bionic mechanisms.

It is unpleasantly viscous.

name: Liquid Propane
description:
(C<sub>3</sub>H<sub>8</sub>) Propane is an alkane.

This selection is in a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

It is useful in <link="POWER">Power</link> production.

name: Molten Tungsten
description: (W) Molten Tungsten is a crystalline <link="REFINEDMETAL">Metal</link> heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Petroleum
description:
Petroleum is a <link="POWER">Power</link> source refined from <link="CRUDEOIL">Crude Oil</link>.

It is also an essential ingredient in the production of <link="POLYPROPYLENE">Plastic</link>.

name: Molten Salt
description: (NaCl) Molten Salt is an edible chemical compound that has been heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Molten Cobalt
description: (Co) Molten Cobalt is a <link="REFINEDMETAL">Refined Metal</link> heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Brine
description:
Brine is a natural, highly concentrated solution of <link="SALT">Salt</link> dissolved in <link="WATER">Water</link>.

It can be used in desalination processes, separating out usable salt.

name: Liquid Nuclear Waste
description: Highly toxic liquid full of <link="RADIATION">Radioactive Contaminants</link> which emit <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link> that can be absorbed by <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Radbolt Generators</link>.

name: Super Coolant
description:
Super Coolant is an industrial-grade coolant that utilizes the unusual energy states of <link="FULLERENE">Fullerene</link>.

This selection is in a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Ethanol
description:
(C<sub>2</sub>H<sub>6</sub>O) Ethanol is an advanced chemical compound in a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

It can be used as a highly effective fuel source when burned.

name: Phyto Oil
description: Phyto Oil is a thick, slippery <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> extracted from pureed <link="SLIME">Slime</link>.

name: Brackene
description:
Brackene is a sodium-rich <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

It is useful in <link="RANCHING">Ranching</link>.

name: Liquid Methane
description:
(CH<sub>4</sub>) Methane is an alkane.

This selection is in a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Molten Iron
description: (Fe) Molten Iron is a common industrial <link="METAL">Metal</link> heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Liquid Carbon
description: (C) Liquid Carbon is an abundant, versatile element heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Molten Zinc
description: Molten Zinc is <link="ZINC">Zinc</link> heated into <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Squid Ink
description:
Squid Ink is a heavily pigmented organic <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> composed of <link="MUCUS">Mucin</link>, melanin, and <link="REFINEDCARBON">Refined Carbon</link>.

It possesses useful <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link> absorption properties.

name: Nectar
description: Nectar is a natural, lightly concentrated solution of <link="SUCROSE">Sucrose</link> dissolved in <link="WATER">Water</link>.

name: Liquid Naphtha
description: Naphtha a distilled hydrocarbon mixture produced from the burning of <link="POLYPROPYLENE">Plastic</link>.

name: Resin
description:
Resin is a viscous organic <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

It can be treated to become <link="POLYPROPYLENE">Plastic</link> in the <link="POLYMERIZER">Polymer Press</link>.

name: Liquid Sucrose
description: (C<sub>12</sub>H<sub>22</sub>O<sub>11</sub>) Liquid Sucrose is the raw form of sugar, heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Liquid Phosphorus
description:
(P) Phosphorus is a chemical element.

This selection is in a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Molten Steel
description: Molten Steel is a <link="METAL">Metal</link> alloy of iron and carbon, heated into a hazardous <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Molten Niobium
description: (Nb) Molten Niobium is a rare metal heated into a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> state.

name: Mucin
description:
Mucin is an extremely viscous <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> gel composed of natural enzymes and polysaccharides.

Its unusually thick consistency can result in formations atypical of most liquids.

name: Ovolene
description:
Ovolene is a protein-rich <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> produced by aquatic critters.

It can be processed into <link="CAVIAR">Caviar</link> and <link="MUCUS">Mucin</link>.
